unit.why: A single anecdote: the tsaddik stays with the wealthy R. Yozpa and offers him a choice of fates. The choice is then fulfilled.

stories.start_quote: בספר בית משולם מידי"נ הרב מפלונסק
stories.end_quote: שתי שנים רצופים עד יום מותו ל״ע
stories.summary_en: The tsaddik lodges for several days with the wealthy R. Yozpa. Before leaving, he makes him choose between long life in poverty, wealth with suffering, or bad sons. Yozpa chooses suffering and dies at about 52 after two years of painful illness.
